    Payment FAQ

    When should I make payment?

    Payment is collected after service completion. You can pay immediately using this portal or via phone after our technician completes the work.

    What payment methods are accepted?

    We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), cash, and digital payments. All online payments processed through Stripe.

    Is online payment secure?

    Yes! We use Stripe, a PCI-compliant payment processor trusted by millions. Your card information is encrypted and never stored on our servers.

    Do you offer payment plans?

    For larger commercial projects, we can discuss payment arrangements. Contact us at (941) 587-5050 to discuss your specific needs.
